Then master alloy rods were cut from the ingot by electro-discharge machining (EDM).
The melt temperature was set at 1980 °C and the directional solidifications were designed at a drawing rate of 500 μm/s with a Ga-In-Sn coolant.
the heat treatment was carried out in a high vacuum heat treatment furnace at 1450 °C for 12 h. Then the sample bars were cooled down to room temperature in the furnace.
